errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.sub: Enter the email address your astrologer invited. We will send you a sign-in link and a code.
signIn.noPassword: No password needed. The link and the code work once, for 15 minutes.
signIn.checkSub: If {email} has access to a client portal, a sign-in link and a six-digit code are on their way. Open the link, or type the code here.
signIn.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.

link.title: Sign in to your portal
link.sub: Press the button to finish signing in on this device.
link.invalid: Sign-in links work once, for 15 minutes. Ask for a new one — it only takes a moment.

invitation.title: Your client portal
invitation.sub: {practice} invited you to see your appointments and what they share with you, in one private place.
invitation.switching: You are signed in as {email}. Accepting signs you in with the invited address instead.
invitation.privacy: {practice} decides what you see here. You sign in with a link or code sent to your address — there is no password.

expired.title: This invitation has expired
expired.body: Invitations work for seven days. Ask {practice} to send you a new one.

used.title: This invitation was already accepted
used.body: Sign in with your email address to open your portal.

revoked.title: This invitation is no longer valid
revoked.body: A newer invitation may have been sent — use the latest email from {practice}.

unavailable.title: This invitation cannot be used now

failed.title: This invitation could not be accepted
failed.body: It may have expired or been used meanwhile. Please contact {practice}.

missing.title: Open the link from your email
missing.body: This page needs the full link from your invitation email. If you already accepted it, sign in instead.

choose.title: Choose a practice
choose.sub: Your address has access to more than one practice. Each one opens on its own.

noAccess.title: Your portal is not open at the moment
noAccess.body: There is no practice you can open right now. If you think this is a mistake, please contact your astrologer.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: There is nothing at this address.
